content: You're waiting for t1 (Logger/Shared State) before starting t4. Key requirements: 1) execution_layer_v2.py must have set_token() method so the GUI can pass MCP token dynamically. 2) Auto-reconnect on EVERY MCP call (not just init) — wrap _call_mcp with retry+reconnect. 3) Magic number 20791 on every order. 4) Comment format 'LSW-V2-{event_id}'. 5) Log BEFORE sending order (call logger_v2.log_signal first). 6) Poll positions every 30s when MCP disconnected. 7) Graceful degradation — GUI stays alive showing disconnected state.
